name: Rising Scholars 2.0 at West Hills College – Lemoore
description: Lemoore College's Rising Scholars 2.0 Program is designed to provide comprehensive support to formerly incarcerated and justice-involved students seeking a college education by helping them overcome obstacles and thrive in their educational journey. Community college offers the following programs: child development, culinary arts, business, entrepreneurship, hospitality management, kinesiology, psychology, project management, paramedic, trades and industrial programs, general education courses and training.
